items.question: What are your routes and schedules?
items.answer: See our full Routes & Schedule on the homepage.

items.question: How can I book a trip?
items.answer: Visit our Book Your Trip page for step-by-step instructions for both passengers and cargo.

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: If you booked in advance online, your refund amount depends on how close to departure you cancel: 90% of the base fare if cancelled more than 48 hours before departure, 75% if cancelled within 48–24 hours, and 50% if cancelled within 24 hours of departure (a portion covers shipping-line and processing fees). If we need to cancel or reschedule your trip, you'll receive a full refund with no surcharge. If you booked directly at the port, this policy is still pending confirmation from staff — please contact our office directly (see Contact Us) to discuss a refund.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Cancellations follow the same tiers as our refund policy above, based on how close to departure you cancel. Please contact our office directly (see Contact Us) to process a cancellation.

items.question: Can I change the date of my booked trip?
items.answer: If you booked in advance online, you can rebook to a new date within 3 months of your original booking, as long as you notify us at least 48 hours before your intended new departure. A 10% surcharge applies if you rebook more than 24 hours before your original scheduled trip, or 20% if within 24 hours. If we need to reschedule your trip, there's no surcharge. If you booked directly at the port, date changes currently aren't available — please contact our office directly to discuss options.

items.question: How can I suggest new routes?
items.answer: We welcome route suggestions from travelers and shippers. Use the form on our homepage under "Suggest a New Route."

items.question: I have a complaint. How do I reach out?
items.answer: Please contact our office directly (see Contact Us) by phone or email, and select "Complaint" as the subject if using our contact form.

items.question: Are you hiring at the moment?
items.answer: See our Careers page for open roles, or reach out via email or through the contact form to inquire.
